In the case of the American Art Clay Company, Inc., more commonly referred to as Amaco, a bit of craziness, passion, and dedication have served us well. AMACO continues to be a leader and innovator for ceramics in the areas of art, technology, and education. Our History Not many companies can say that they’ve been in business for 100 years and counting–and almost anyone would agree that such longevity is a pretty remarkable event. American Art Clay Company, Inc. (AMACO) is proud to claim this distinction, celebrating with a new building, new products, and an optimistic outlook for the next 100 years. In 2004, AMACO moved to new facilities with 50% more space than their former building. It was no small task to move a company of this size… it took 120 trailers to transport inventory, furniture, and equipment from the old building to their new location. 1919 Making the first American modeling clay 1921 Publishing first Lesson Plans for art teachers 1930 Operating a fine art deco production pottery 1934 Making the first electric kiln for school and studio use 1936 Becoming a founding member of ACMI 1947 Making the first electric potter's wheel 1950 Begins workshop series for teachers, John Herron School of Art 1951 Introducing the first lead free glaze to the industry 1960 Launches first traveling workshop nationwide 1960's Operating an exotic zoo for school tours 1964 Launching Rub ‘n Buff®—the ‘Original’ wax metallic finish 1976 Establishing the first glaze labeling safety practices with ACMI 1978 Buying Brent® Potters Wheels & Equipment 1979 Acquires Reward Glazes and introduces Velvet Underglazes 1982 Developing the first adaptable potter’s wheel for the physically challenged 1989 Acquires Friendly Plastic which becomes a huge craft craze 2004 Moves headquarters to new facility after 75 years near the Indianapolis Motor Speedway 2004 AMACO/Brent Contemporary Clay Gallery opens 2009 Manufacturing Brent® products with recycled materials Distributors Near you Where to buy Amaco products Locate a dealer Join the team Careers at AMACO View Current Openings Find a Distributor Glazes & Underglazes Glazes & Underglazes Menu Underglazes Velvet Underglaze Velvet Sprayz Liquid Underglaze Semi-Moist Underglazes Underglazes Chalk Crayons and Pencils Ceramic Inks Low Fire Glazes Low Fire Gloss Low Fire Matte Opalescent Teacher's Palette Teacher's Palette Light Dipping Glazes Mid-High Fire Glazes Pearlescent Glazes - NEW!
